items.title: Rudolph Beaulieu Interview, 1961-05-31
items.q: I heard my brother, this fella, tell me his name was Valtu... I was in that one they had Joe Oliver, that old man Valtu. I think they had about five pieces in there... Because I was peeping in that window like a transom I was looking.

ctx.x: 25, that's right. Big 25. And they had a fella by the name. I heard my brother, this fella, tell me his name was Valtu.
Oh, yeah. I've heard that. Professor Vanetta talks about him a lot.
